stem: Julio did not write an effective thesis for this paper. He would like to delete sentences 4 and 5 and replace them with two sentences that better articulate his thesis. Which of the following should he use?

options.label: A
options.text: Wind turbines aren’t anything new. They have been around for a long time.

options.label: B
options.text: People come up with new ideas. And new ideas mean creative solutions for all.

options.label: C
options.text: This wind turbine is unique. It can produce both energy and water.

options.label: D
options.text: A wind turbine may be the perfect answer. Experts believe this is true.
